description: Monthly time series of BORME activity for a company (number of registry acts per month, `series: [{period: "2024-05", count: 2}]`). Useful to spot dormant companies or bursts of corporate activity.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_activity
